notes: Selected from 22 inspected candidate Wix/small-site local-service leads. Two initially selected workers timed out and were dropped before finalization so only complete packages are included.

items.name: Syverson Pressure Washing LLC
items.summary: Rochester pressure-washing Wix site with real branding, service range, Jobber quote link, contact info, and a customer review; prototype tightens the first-screen service message, proof, and quote path.
items.angle: make the first screen clearly say Rochester pressure washing, surface-safe services, proof, and a faster quote path

items.name: Ark Property Services, LLC
items.summary: Michigan property-services Wix page with project photos, phone/email, and broad service scope; prototype corrects template leftovers, clarifies services, and moves estimate actions higher.
items.angle: make the page consistently say Ark Property Services, show call and email-photo options near the top, label the main services, and clean up template leftovers

items.name: Brandon Construction
items.summary: New Jersey construction/remodeling Wix site with service categories, license number, phone/email, and contact form; prototype improves first impression, service clarity, proof, and estimate flow.
items.angle: make the page feel like a real local remodeling option in the first few seconds with clearer services, trust cues, and estimate actions

items.name: Karim's Pro Service Etc
items.summary: Georgia handyman/exterior-services Wix page with phone, email, services, family-owned wording, testimonials, and a quote form; prototype clarifies top services and the quote request path.
items.angle: make handyman and exterior services clearer in the first screen, add stronger call/email buttons, and explain what to send for a quote

items.name: Gonzalez Handyman and Junk Removal Services
items.summary: Stockton handyman and junk-removal Wix site with logo, phone/email, location, service prices, and multiple service pages; prototype routes visitors to the right service and stronger call/request actions.
items.angle: keep the bold red Gonzalez look while routing visitors clearly to handyman repairs, general maintenance, or junk removal with stronger call and request-service actions

items.name: Home Fixers LLC
items.summary: San Antonio handyman Wix site with service areas, licensed/insured messaging, badges, long service list, and a contact form; prototype raises service clarity, trust cues, and phone/email estimate actions.
items.angle: make the first screen clearly say San Antonio handyman and home repair services, add stronger call/email actions, bring trust cues higher, and make common services easier to scan

items.name: Home Hero
items.summary: Memorable superhero-themed Wix site with real service photo, contact info, and quote form; prototype keeps the personality while clarifying services, local availability, and next steps.
items.angle: keep the Home Hero personality while making the hero copy more readable, clarifying services and CT service area, and tightening the quote instructions

items.name: First Generation Fencing Inc
items.summary: Sacramento fence-installation Wix site with license number, phone, local areas, and project imagery; prototype improves estimate CTAs, service detail, testimonial visibility, and placeholder sections.
items.angle: make call and email estimate actions more obvious, bring service areas and fence materials higher, and replace blank-looking sections with useful estimate and testimonial content
